name: com.testingreference/testing-reference
title: Testing Reference
description: Cited facts on electrical testing across 18 reference sites: standards, methods, NEC adoption.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search over page titles, descriptions and datum statements. Returns matching pages and datums with their canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One subject page (family and slug), with its article when published and every published datum about the subject.

family.description: Page family, for example tests, standards, equipment, instruments, products, glossary or nec-adoption.

tools.name: get_datum
tools.description: One datum (a single sourced fact) by its case-sensitive id, for example nec.adoption.NV, with its source, clause and review status.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Every source cited by a published datum: designation, edition, publisher, catalog link and the datums that cite it.

tools.name: nec_adoption
tools.description: The National Electrical Code edition in force in a US state or territory, from public records.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Every site of the Testing Reference family: id, name, origin, scope and the number of pages, datums and sources it publishes, with its API and MCP addresses.

tools.name: search_family
tools.description: Full-text search over subject titles, glossary terms and datum statements on every site. Each hit names its home site and the URL of the page that serves it.

tools.name: cite
tools.description: For a datum id published anywhere in the family: the citation text, the page URL on its home site, the source designation and edition, and the retrieval date.

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: Records changed on or after an ISO date on any site of the family, newest first.

tools.name: standard_editions
tools.description: For a designation such as IEEE 43 or NFPA 70B: the editions cited in the family and the sites that hold datums for each.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Two to ten datum ids from any sites of the family: their statements, sources and dates side by side. Values are not included.
